name: OpenBUA
notes: Chrome Manifest V3 extension (manifest version 1.9.1) whose agent loop is built on the pi-agent-core and pi-ai packages. Its tools (src/agent/tools.ts) read a paginated inventory of interactive DOM controls including open shadow roots, inspect forms, click elements or screenshot-pixel coordinates (used for canvas editors such as Google Docs), type, scroll, switch and open tabs, upload files, post to social sites and send webmail; capture_tab_screenshot returns the visible-tab image to the model. Actions run as scripts injected with chrome.scripting that dispatch synthetic pointer and mouse events (src/agent/browser-bridge.ts); the manifest requests no debugger permission. Before showing its human CAPTCHA gate, the bridge makes up to two automatic rounds in which a vision model is asked to click inside detected challenge regions (src/agent/captcha-auto.ts). It acts in the user's logged-in sessions and keeps a memory store with optional parallel worker windows. The README ends with 'MIT', but the inspected tree has no license file. The agent was not run.
summary: Chrome side-panel agent that works in the user's signed-in browser, reading DOM control inventories and tab screenshots, then clicking, typing and filling forms through injected synthetic events.
